author: CharlieHjelly
body:
I was banned on May 31st 2015 2:37:57 Pm GMT for flying/ gliding when i was simply lagging. I jumped off a structure when i was at 2 fps and for a moderator it looked like i was gliding/flying yet i was not. I ask you to un-ban me as i have got a new laptop to fix my lag so you won't be confused any more. Please consider i have many friends who i would like to have fun with on your amazing server. Thank you for reading and i hope you are reasonable with your choice.

From CharlieHjelly a guy who would like to go back on your amazing server.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have looked for evidence to support this ban, but couldn't find it. I am happy for you to be unbanned, as I can't back up my claims that you were hacking. I'll let a senior deal with the rest of this appeal.

Regards,
Pelp.
